d:
Thailand trip ke tickets toh full booked nikle, toh socha kyun na Thailand ke flavours ghar par hi le aayein!
Iss vlog mein bana raha hoon Thai Green Chicken Curry aur Thailand ka fragrant Hom Mali Jasmine Rice, apni family ke liye. Cooking ke saath hui dher saari family banter, favourite Thai dishes ki baatein aur Thailand ki yaadein.
Aur phir shuru hua ek mazedaar quiz, jahan sahi jawab dene par milti thi bird's eye chilli se bachne ki chance! Dekhiye kaun jeeta aur kiski zubaan par chadh gaya teekha challenge!
